items.title: Albert Francis Interview, 1961-08-04
items.q: Black Benny used to come and try to get lessons from me.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, I never knew him. I heard people talking.
Yeah, he was good too, Hendriss Eno. You remember who he played with? Well, he used to play all in my club, different band. And Black, we were talking Black Benny. Yeah. Little Red Happy.
Yeah, I never knew him either. I never knew Black Benny. I heard people talking.
